skyline.title: Skyline Stretch Ceilings
skyline.summary: A modern website with a premium aesthetic that introduces Canadian customers to stretch ceilings and integrated lighting, showcases design possibilities, and highlights the company’s expertise.
skyline.context: The company was reaching a Canadian audience with a product that was still unfamiliar to many potential customers. The website needed to present stretch ceilings as a modern interior solution, with premium finishes, integrated lighting, and a variety of design possibilities. The aim was to help visitors imagine the result in their own space and interest them in discussing a project.
skyline.task: Build a website that explains the product, helps people compare options and provides a clear way to request an estimate. Before making contact, visitors need to understand the material, assess its appearance and know what installation will involve in their home.
journey: See the ceiling in a room

solutions.title: Design that draws attention
solutions.body: A large opening photograph shows the combined effect of the ceiling and lighting. The following section explains the tensioned system.

solutions.title: Different solutions for different interiors
solutions.body: Cards for glossy and translucent ceilings, light lines and other treatments make the finishes easier to compare.

solutions.title: Work shown in context
solutions.body: The gallery presents ceilings in residential and commercial interiors. Visitors can judge scale, lighting geometry and the relationship with the furnishings.

solutions.title: A clear installation process
solutions.body: The website explains how stretch ceilings are installed, from consultation to the finished result. This helps customers prepare for the work and feel more confident before placing an order.

solutions.title: FAQs that help customers decide
solutions.body: This section explains materials, lighting, maintenance, and installation. Customers can find answers to the main questions in advance.

solutions.title: An easy way to request an estimate
solutions.body: Customers can get in touch through WhatsApp or the website form, describe their room, and share photographs. This makes it easier to introduce the project and start a consultation.

skyline.galleryBody: The catalogue helps answer which ceiling might suit a visitor, while the gallery shows how an idea looks in a room. The two sections work together: one helps people name an option, the other helps them imagine it in their own space.
skyline.mobileBody: The mobile version retains the website’s style and visual appeal. Customers can explore interior solutions, learn about their benefits, and easily request an estimate.
skyline.outcome: The company received a modern website with a premium visual presentation, introducing stretch ceilings and integrated lighting to a Canadian audience. It provides a professional online presence and a starting point for introducing potential customers to a product that is new to them.
skyline.resultNote: Actual enquiry and sales figures were not provided, so the website’s commercial results are not assessed.

maryna.title: Maryna Cleaning
maryna.summary: We updated the cleaning company’s website for Google Ads so visitors arriving from an ad could immediately find the right service, see indicative pricing and work results, and submit an enquiry.
maryna.context: People arriving from an ad already have a specific need: regular cleaning, deep cleaning, preparing a home for a move, or another service. The website needs to answer their main questions quickly: is the service available, does the company cover my area, roughly how much does it cost, and can I trust this company with my home?
maryna.task: Update the website so a click from an ad leads to answers. Show the services, coverage area, starting rates, and ways to get in touch. The form needs to collect enough information for the company to confirm pricing and availability.
maryna.note: The redesign was part of the work on the website and Google Ads.

solutions.title: Each service has its own place
solutions.body: Regular, deep, move-out, and commercial cleaning are presented separately. Customers can quickly find what they need without unnecessary searching.

solutions.title: The service area is clear from the start
solutions.body: Visitors can see the coverage area before filling out an enquiry. They can quickly check whether the company is right for them.

solutions.title: Clear pricing before getting in touch
solutions.body: Pricing without unpleasant surprises. We showed starting rates and explained what determines the final cost, helping customers plan their budget in advance.

solutions.title: Real work and reviews build trust
solutions.body: Before-and-after photographs show the quality of the cleaning, while reviews help customers feel confident in their choice.

solutions.title: Answers before the first enquiry
solutions.body: The FAQ brings together information about the cleaning process, products, duration, and other details customers usually ask about before booking.

solutions.title: An enquiry with the details of the future booking
solutions.body: Customers specify the service, area, and property details. The company receives the information needed for an initial estimate and follow-up.

maryna.galleryBody: Visitors can explore services, starting prices, and real work results in one place, without searching social media or calling about every detail. This helps them form a first impression of the company and move towards booking with greater confidence.
maryna.mobileBody: We adapted the website for mobile devices so customers can browse services, assess the offer, and submit an enquiry without unnecessary difficulty.
maryna.outcome: Maryna Cleaning received an updated website with a modern design, real cleaning results, and a convenient enquiry form. The company now has a complete destination for Google Ads traffic, where potential customers can get to know the business, assess service quality, and request a cleaning. The owner also praised the combined work on the website and advertising, mentioning regular bookings, attention to detail, and a responsible approach to the project.
maryna.resultNote: This is the owner's assessment of the combined engagement. There is no data to isolate the redesign's contribution, independently verify advertising returns or calculate website conversion.

tile.title: Tile Expert Solutions
tile.summary: Improvements to an existing contractor website. A look at the current version: services, project examples and estimate requests.
tile.technology: WordPress, as reported by the client
tile.context: The company offers tile installation and remodeling in Minnesota. Visitors are choosing a contractor for a particular space. They need to find relevant work, examine examples and understand who will be responsible for the result.
tile.task: Our involvement was to improve an existing website. The exact change list is no longer available. The practical purpose of the current page is to help visitors choose a service and provide initial details for an estimate. That is an analysis of its role, not a reconstructed project brief.
tile.note: The analysis below concerns the current public website. Its sections and design are not attributed to our work: without a change archive, we cannot establish which were part of our contribution.

solutions.title: Services named by the task
solutions.body: Kitchen backsplashes, kitchen or bathroom remodeling and damaged tile replacement appear as separate services. Visitors can identify their situation without decoding a general construction list. An estimate link alongside a service connects that choice with an enquiry.

solutions.title: Materials help refine an enquiry
solutions.body: The surface types section describes tile and other finishes. It gives visitors vocabulary for discussing materials and how a space will be used. The company can start with a more specific need while leaving the final selection to a consultation.

solutions.title: Projects make workmanship visible
solutions.body: Photographs allow visitors to examine finishes and material combinations in rooms. They provide a visual reference for a future renovation. These are the contractor's published examples; photographs alone cannot verify the full scope of services or guarantee an identical result elsewhere.

solutions.title: A person behind the offer
solutions.body: The founder section introduces the contractor and describes his experience and approach. Contact information and location add context. Visitors can understand who they will be speaking to, while the company has space to explain its specialisation.

solutions.title: An estimate suited to the work
solutions.body: Renovation scope depends on the space and the task, so the site invites an estimate request. This is a practical next step: visitors do not need to derive a total from a list of services. The contractor can first clarify the property's condition and the customer's expectations.

solutions.title: A short form starts the conversation
solutions.body: The form asks for a name, phone number, ZIP code and project type. These details allow the business to make contact, check the area and identify the kind of work. Further questions can follow. This describes the existing form and makes no claim about who developed it.

tile.galleryBody: The service list helps visitors find a relevant category, and project photographs turn descriptions into examples. These screenshots document how that relationship appears on the live website at the time of review.
tile.mobileBody: Visitors can read about the offer and reach the estimate form on a phone. A small set of fields provides a clear starting point for discussing a renovation. The mobile screenshots document the current site and do not represent a before-and-after comparison of our work.
tile.outcome: Participation in improving an existing website is confirmed. Today's public version presents services, projects, contractor information and an estimate channel. These describe functions available to the business; the available evidence cannot establish which resulted from our involvement.
tile.resultNote: The change list and original version are unavailable. No enquiry, conversion or sales-impact data was provided, so no numerical outcome is claimed.
